tasks.title: Bind Telos transitions to live host authority
tasks.body:
objective: Replace the generic Telos capability path with an exact, live host-owned transition boundary.
deliverable: TDD implementation and adversarial tests proving forged rows plus an unrelated live authority cannot activate or roll back Telos.
in_scope: tools/approval.py, hermes_cli/evolution/telos_approval.py, hermes_cli/evolution/telos_store.py, exact Telos authority tests.
out_of_scope: Gateway wiring, schema migration, TypeScript, remote backend, other Project B repairs.
workspace: current codex/autopoiesis-project-b-design worktree at base commit 5924446cd507c72c9edfb37f416f07c9e52ec54a.
write_scope: tools/approval.py; hermes_cli/evolution/telos_approval.py; hermes_cli/evolution/telos_store.py; tests/hermes_cli/evolution/test_telos_adversarial.py; tests/hermes_cli/evolution/test_telos_approval_security.py; tests/hermes_cli/evolution/test_telos_contract_and_store.py.
input_evidence: autopoiesis_repair_2.2.1_prompt.md and the approved Project B specification.
dependencies: none.
acceptance_criteria: exact request, organism, digest, action, surface, actor, session/channel, nonce, context, expiry and single-use binding; persistent rows are audit-only; no pointer/LKG mutation on rejection; caller-owned ledgers remain open.
required_verification: genuine RED then GREEN node receipts; focused Telos suites; no skips, xfails or weakened expectations.
return_schema: changed_files, commits, red_green_receipts, verification_commands, residual_risks.

tasks.title: Migrate Telos approval audit chains to coherent v5
tasks.body:
objective: Make the persistent Telos approval audit chain relationally coherent without redefining v4.
deliverable: Explicit v4-to-v5 migration, fresh-v5 schema and direct-SQL adversarial coverage.
in_scope: evolution ledger schema/migrations, repository current-version gate, migration and schema tests.
out_of_scope: host adapters, TypeScript, remote backend, destructive rewriting of historical Project A rows.
workspace: current codex/autopoiesis-project-b-design worktree after AUTO-221-1.
write_scope: hermes_cli/evolution/ledger.py; hermes_cli/evolution/suggestions.py; schema and migration test files named below.
input_evidence: cross-wired request-A/decision-B reproduction in autopoiesis_repair_2.2.1_prompt.md.
dependencies: AUTO-221-1.
acceptance_criteria: schema version 5; request-decision-grant-consumption coherence; context and expiry enforcement; append-only guarantees; incoherent v4 evidence preserved but excluded from authority; v1 through v5 migration chain remains atomic and idempotent.
required_verification: genuine RED/GREEN direct-SQL nodes, fresh-v5, v4-to-v5, rollback-on-failure, repeated-open and Project A preservation tests.
return_schema: changed_files, commits, migration_contract, red_green_receipts, verification_commands, residual_risks.

tasks.title: Complete the Gateway Telos host transition
tasks.body:
objective: Wire the shared host authority through real Gateway slash dispatch.
deliverable: /approve telos and denial behavior that bind the real MessageEvent and complete exactly one activation or rollback.
in_scope: Gateway slash-command routing and dedicated Gateway Telos tests.
out_of_scope: classic CLI prompt, TUI Gateway, Ink, Desktop, remote backend.
workspace: current codex/autopoiesis-project-b-design worktree after AUTO-221-1 and AUTO-221-2.
write_scope: gateway/slash_commands.py and tests/gateway/test_telos_approval_commands.py.
input_evidence: current handler records only a decision and falsely returns approved.
dependencies: AUTO-221-1 and AUTO-221-2.
acceptance_criteria: real MessageEvent actor/session/channel binding; exact pending request; approve and deny only; no all/session/always inheritance; success returned only after completed transition; authority revoked in finally; bounded failure text.
required_verification: real-dispatch RED/GREEN nodes plus existing dangerous-command approval regression.
return_schema: changed_files, commits, dispatch_test_receipts, regression_commands, residual_risks.

tasks.title: Remove suite-order and static-check blockers
tasks.body:
objective: Remove only the currently reproduced integration blockers required to verify Repair Pass 2.2.1.
deliverable: Order-independent default-root config test and clean Ruff/compileall/diff checks.
in_scope: narrow global_config import/path fix, explicit UTF-8 encodings and its existing isolation test.
out_of_scope: complete global-config semantics, command routing, Observer, session pinning, migration, TypeScript, remote backend.
workspace: current codex/autopoiesis-project-b-design worktree after AUTO-221-1 through AUTO-221-3.
write_scope: hermes_cli/evolution/global_config.py and tests/hermes_cli/evolution/test_config_breaker_isolation.py.
input_evidence: full Evolution suite fails test_global_config_isolated_from_profile because the module caches get_default_hermes_root; Ruff reports two PLW1514 errors.
dependencies: AUTO-221-1, AUTO-221-2 and AUTO-221-3.
acceptance_criteria: test passes both alone and in full suite; profile bytes remain unchanged; explicit UTF-8; no expansion into pending global-config behavior.
required_verification: focused config test, full Evolution suite, exact fourteen deferred tests, changed-file Ruff, compileall and git diff check.
return_schema: changed_files, commits, focused_result, full_suite_result, static_check_results, residual_risks.
